verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a free tier or says which editor and collaboration features are available without a paid seat. The docs describe editor capabilities and multi-person editing via Revision History, but none of it is tied to a plan. The only pricing evidence is community comments about $25–$39/month and Rive charging for the editor, which suggests paid access rather than a usable free tier.

support.subject: As a designer, the free tier supports real design work — usable editor and collaboration without a paid seat
